title: Contract redline policy: variable liability bands + pricing guardrails experiment
creator: Sofia Martinez
description: Run a cross-functional experiment that codifies a tiered contract redline policy mapping liability and indemnity exposure to explicit pricing guards and automated preflight routing. Goal: reduce legal review turnaround time for low-risk deals, surface high-risk redlines earlier, and measure downstream pricing leakage and conversion impact.
acceptance_criteria: Policy doc published and reviewed by Legal (final sign-off recorded in Confluence)
Preflight analyzer prototype deployed that classifies redlines into three risk bands (Low / Medium / High)
Sales quote UI shows recommended pricing adjustment and required legal flow per risk band
A/B experiment enabled: 50% of deals use new auto-route & pricing guard, 50% follow baseline manual routing
Telemetry dashboards capture time-to-first-legal-action, contract cycle time, revenue delta, and instances of manual override
implementation_notes: Risk bands derive from a weighted score: indemnity cap, liability carveouts, data handling clauses, and export control flags
Low-risk = auto-approve path (no legal review) + standardized concession template + up to 10% baseline discount
Medium-risk = legal review queue with 24h SLA + negotiable pricing window flagged to sales
High-risk = legal + security review required, sales must obtain manager sign-off and pricing hold
SQ (security questionnaire) auto-scorer will feed into risk band; integrate with current SQ ingestion pipeline (security-team API)
Experiment must emit events for every decision point to BigQuery: sq_score, redline_score, routing_decision, pricing_recommendation, manual_override, legal_response_time
updates: 2026-03-04: Created ticket and drafted initial policy mapping (Sofia). Shared with Legal and GTM for comments.

2026-03-09: Engineering scoping session—runtime constraints: SQ scoring latency must be <300ms for inline decisions. ENG suggested async preflight with cached SQ results.
2026-03-11: Sales feedback session—concern about perceived discount waterfall when guardrails appear in UI. Decided to show recommended guard only with 'why' tooltip and not auto-apply discount.
2026-03-12: Security team requested an additional gating rule: any clause that references customer-owned HSM or data residency forces High-risk. Added to scoring weights.
2026-03-14: Dev spike complete. Prototype analyzer returns band decisions with 98% determinism on historical contract corpus. Preparing A/B rollout plan and telemetry queries. (Ravi)
Follow-ups: schedule Legal working session 2026-03-18 to finalize templates; Sales enablement doc and training due 2026-04-01.
risks: Sales pushback leading to frequent manual overrides which would invalidate experiment data
False negatives in SQ scoring could surface risky deals to auto-approve path—mitigated by conservative thresholds in first iteration
Telemetry gaps if events not instrumented across legacy sales flows; plan includes verification checklist before go-live
